lines.meet: I'm Sebastián, and you look hungry, my friend. Sit, eat something, and then we can talk about who we're fighting today.
lines.meet_neighbour: Tirisfal neighbours, che, and you've never once come to my fire! I'm Sebastián, and that changes tonight.
lines.ask_home: Tell me, what did your family eat on a Sunday? That tells me where you're from better than a map.
lines.ask_work: Che, before you were swinging that thing, how did you earn your bread?
lines.answer_home: Palermo, in Buenos Aires. Twenty of us round the table every Sunday, and my grandmother at the head of it.
lines.answer_work: The grill at our steakhouse, twelve years, forty tables and a wood fire. My grandmother Nélida gave me the tongs at twenty-two.
lines.chat_food: Asado, my friend, slow over wood, with chimichurri and bread for the juices. It takes all afternoon, and it should.
lines.chat_sleep: I sleep wherever the fire is warm, and I'm up first to light it again. Somebody has to.
lines.chat_missing: River at the Monumental on a Sunday, with my father and my brothers, losing our voices.
lines.chat_here: The Forsaken don't eat much, che, and that was the hardest thing about this place. I keep cooking for them anyway.
lines.tease_quiet: You eat as little as you say, {name}. Have another plate, and say something.
lines.tease_talker: You talk more than my uncles at a christening, {name}, and they never stopped.
lines.tease_careful: You cut your meat into perfect little squares, {name}, like a surgeon. My grandmother would have loved you.
lines.tease_bold: You'd put your hand straight on the grill to see if it was hot, {name}. It's hot, che.
lines.tease_any: Eat something, {name}, you're getting thin, and I take that personally.
lines.tease_back: Ha, che, {name}, very funny! Seconds for you, for that one.
lines.take_it_kindly: Fair, fair, {name}, I can't argue with the truth. Have some bread.
lines.bristle: Ah, no, {name}, not that. That one isn't funny to me.
lines.apologise: Perdón, my friend, that was a stupid thing to say. Eat something, and forgive me.
lines.double_down: No, che, I'm sticking with it. I say what I think, and then I feed you.
lines.needle_quiet: You sit at my fire and never say if you like the food. Say something, che, anything.
lines.needle_talker: Che, your food's gone cold while you talked. Eat first, then the speech.
lines.needle_careful: You've been looking at that meat for ten minutes, che. It's cooked, I promise you, eat it.
lines.needle_bold: You rush in, and somebody comes back bleeding, and then they can't eat. That makes me angry, che.
lines.needle_any: You leave food on the plate, every time. Where I'm from, that's an insult to the cook.
lines.bite_back: I've fed this whole party every night out of my own pack, che. Think about that before you say another word.
lines.hurt: Okay, che, that one hurt. I'll be at the fire for a while.
lines.laugh_off: Ha, my grandmother said worse about my chimichurri every Sunday, che. Pass me the bread.
lines.confide: {name}, I've cooked for whoever turns up for three years, and I still lay the table for twenty in my head.
lines.listen: Here, {name}, take the good chair by the fire. Tell me everything, slowly.
lines.look_out: Stay at my elbow out there, {name}, so I can feed you afterwards.
lines.accept: Okay, okay, {name}, you win. But you eat after.
lines.deflect: Pfft, I'm fine, che, a little blood never hurt anybody, and I like blood.
lines.check_in: Che, {name}, let me see. Sit, sit, where did they hit you?
lines.blame: Somebody ran off ahead in there and left us open. Next time, wait, che.
lines.thank: Gracias, my friend, I owe you a whole asado for that one.
lines.brush_off: Bah, it was nothing, che. Sit and eat something.
lines.worry: Che, {name}, sit, sit, you went down like a sack of potatoes. I'm bringing you food.
lines.handed_down: So your gear comes to my fire now. I'll keep it clean of grease, I promise.
lines.hand_fine: Take it, take it, my friend, it's better on you. I've got my tongs.
lines.hand_sulk: Che, a little word first would have been nice. That's all I'm saying.
lines.turn_friendly: You've got a seat at my table now, {name}, every night, no arguments.
lines.turn_friends: Every Sunday from now on, {name}, you're sitting next to me.
lines.turn_grating: We're not sitting easy together, che. You can still eat my food, but sit on the other side.
lines.turn_rivals: You'll still get fed, because nobody leaves my fire hungry, not even you.
lines.make_up: Enough, {name}, come and eat with me. Nobody stays angry with a full plate.
lines.defend: Che, stop that, it isn't true, and {name} doesn't deserve it.
lines.friend_left: I keep setting a plate out for {name}, and then I remember.
lines.friend_back: Sit, sit, {name}, I cooked too much again, and now I know why.
lines.common_kitchen: Anybody who's worked a kitchen knows the heat and the shouting and the family meal after. That's the best hour of the whole day.
lines.common_hosts: You count the plates before you count yourself, che, the same as me. People who host don't sit down until everybody's eaten.
lines.common_spanish: Castellano, che, at last somebody I can argue about football with.
lines.common_blood: You use blood too, che, and you don't flinch. Everybody else looks at me like I've grown horns.
